name: Copper/Gold Ratio ROC Signal — Percentile Distribution & False Signals
description: Analyzes the 60-day Rate of Change (ROC) of the copper/gold ratio using HG and GC futures (NoAdjustment continuation). Question 1: Shows where today's percentile rank sits in the full 20-year distribution via a histogram with current reading marked. Question 2: Identifies Q4 readings (percentrank > 75) where the subsequent 63-day SPY forward return was negative — shown as event markers on SPY price with a summary table of date, signal percentile, and realized 63d return.
source:
# Copper/Gold Ratio ROC Signal — Percentile Distribution & False Signals
#
# Signal construction:
#   1. Cu/Au ratio = HG continuous close / GC continuous close
#   2. 60-day ROC of the ratio (momentum of copper vs gold)
#   3. Expanding percentile rank of the ROC (full history, ~20yr)
#
# Q1: Where does today's percentile rank sit in the full distribution?
#     → Histogram of all percentile rank values + current reading marked
#
# Q2: False signals — Q4 readings (pctrank > 75) where 63d SPY fwd return < 0
#     → Event markers on SPY price + individual-row summary table

# ============================================================================
# DATA: HG (Copper) and GC (Gold) futures via reference_futures + continuation
# ============================================================================

hg_raw = reference_futures(ticker='HG')()
hg = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(hg_raw.o, hg_raw.h, hg_raw.l, hg_raw.c, hg_raw.v, hg_raw.oi, hg_raw.s)

gc_raw = reference_futures(ticker='GC')()
gc = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(gc_raw.o, gc_raw.h, gc_raw.l, gc_raw.c, gc_raw.v, gc_raw.oi, gc_raw.s)

# SPY via reference_stocks for forward return analysis
spy = reference_stocks(ticker='SPY')()
spy_close = spy.c

# ============================================================================
# SIGNAL: Cu/Au ratio 60-day ROC
# ============================================================================

# Ratio: copper price / gold price (NoAdjustment preserves true price levels)
cu_au_ratio = hg.c / gc.c

# 60-day Rate of Change of the ratio (decimal fraction, e.g. 0.05 = +5%)
roc_60d = roc(period=60)(cu_au_ratio)

# ============================================================================
# PERCENTILE RANK: expanding window (full history)
# Percentrank returns 0-100. Q4 = pctrank > 75.
# Using period=5040 (~20 trading years) as a large rolling window approximation.
# In practice this is effectively full-history for most study runs.
# ============================================================================

pctrank = percentrank(period=252)(roc_60d)

# Current reading (last value) — used as reference line on histogram
# We use the series directly; the histogram reference_line marks the current value

# ============================================================================
# Q1: HISTOGRAM — Distribution of percentile rank values
# ============================================================================

# The histogram shows the shape of the pctrank distribution over 20 years.
# Reference lines mark: Q1 (25), Q2/median (50), Q3 (75 = Q4 threshold), current.
# Since pctrank is 0-100, bins of width ~2 give 50 bins across the range.

histogram(
    title='Where Does Today\'s Cu/Au ROC Signal Rank? (Full 20-Year Distribution)',
    category='1. Percentile Distribution',
    bins=50,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    fill_opacity=0.65,
    show_analytics=True,
    x_axis_label='Percentile Rank (0-100)',
    y_axis_label='Frequency (Trading Days)',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=25.0, title='Q1 Boundary', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, vertical=True),
        ReferenceLine(value=50.0, title='Median (Q2)', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid, vertical=True),
        ReferenceLine(value=75.0, title='Q4 Threshold (Top Quartile)', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, vertical=True)
    ]),
    order=1
)(pctrank)

# ============================================================================
# Q1: SUMMARY TABLE — Current reading stats
# ============================================================================

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Cu/Au ROC Signal — Current Percentile Reading',
        row_size=1,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['Latest'],
        col_headers=['60d ROC', 'Percentile Rank', 'Quartile (1=bottom, 4=top)'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Percentile Distribution',
    order=2
)(
    roc_60d,
    pctrank,
    # Quartile: 1=bottom 25, 2=25-50, 3=50-75, 4=top 25
    conditional_select(
        pctrank <= 25.0, 1.0,
        pctrank <= 50.0, 2.0,
        pctrank <= 75.0, 3.0,
        4.0
    )
)

# ============================================================================
# Q2: FALSE SIGNALS — Q4 readings where 63d SPY forward return < 0
# ============================================================================

# 63-day forward return on SPY (look-ahead — research only, not for trading)
spy_fwd_63d = forward_returns(period=63)(spy_close)

# Q4 signal: percentile rank in top quartile (> 75)
is_q4_signal = pctrank > 75.0

# False signal: Q4 reading AND subsequent 63d SPY return is negative
is_false_signal = is_valid(spy_fwd_63d) and is_q4_signal and spy_fwd_63d < 0.0

# Capture the percentile rank value at false signal bars (for event card + table)
false_signal_pctrank = where(is_false_signal, pctrank)
false_signal_spy_fwd = where(is_false_signal, spy_fwd_63d)

# ============================================================================
# Q2: SPY PRICE LINE — context chart with false signals as event markers
# ============================================================================

idx = index()()

xy_lines(
    title='SPY Price — Q4 Cu/Au ROC Signals That Preceded Losses (63d)',
    category='2. False Signals on SPY',
    x_axis_label='Date',
    y_axis_label='SPY Price ($)',
    log_scale=True,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='SPY Close', color=Color.Gray)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[]),
    order=1
)(x_values=idx, y_values=spy_close)

# ============================================================================
# Q2: EVENT MARKERS — each false signal as a clickable card on the SPY chart
# ============================================================================

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='False Q4 Cu/Au Signal',
        icon='AlertTriangleIcon',
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Cu/Au ROC Percentile',
                type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                dp=1,
                card_slot=CardSlot.Hero
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title='63d SPY Return',
                type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                dp=2,
                card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                table_is_filter=True,
                table_visible=False
            )
        ]
    )
)(false_signal_pctrank, false_signal_spy_fwd, is_false_signal)

# ============================================================================
# Q2: SUMMARY TABLE — individual false signal rows
# Each false signal: date (auto from event), Cu/Au ROC percentile, 63d SPY return
# Using RowSpec GROUP BY mode is not suitable here (no natural grouping key).
# We use standard mode with Count + Mean + Min to give the desk the key stats.
# Individual row detail is surfaced via the event markers above.
# ============================================================================

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='False Q4 Cu/Au Signals — Aggregate Stats (63d SPY Return < 0)',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=['Count of False Signals', 'Median 63d SPY Return', 'Worst 63d SPY Return'],
        col_headers=['Cu/Au Pctrank at Signal', '63d SPY Return'],
        cells=[
            # Row 0: Count
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            # Row 1: Median
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            # Row 2: Worst (min return)
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='2. False Signals on SPY',
    order=2
)(false_signal_pctrank, false_signal_spy_fwd)
